segments.name: Technical Services
segments.description: Provides well-site oilfield services and equipment with personnel to oil and gas producers for completion, production and maintenance of wells.
segments.evidence: This operating segment consists primarily of pressure pumping, wireline, downhole tools, coiled tubing and cementing.

segments.name: Support Services
segments.description: Provides off-well-site equipment rentals and support services such as pipe inspection, storage and training to oil and gas producers.
segments.evidence: The equipment and services offered include rental tools, drill pipe and related tools, pipe handling, pipe inspection and storage services.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas companies pay RPC for short-term oilfield services at rates based on the specific job, equipment, labor and consumables, generally invoiced upon completion of services.
revenueModel.evidence: Pricing for these services is a function of rates based on the nature of the specific job, with consideration for the extent of equipment, labor, and consumables needed for the job.
